correctness.rationale: The integral composition identity and derivatives at ±2 prove exact p-adic valuations at ramified traces. At nonramified traces, the order of the squared root in a cyclic split/norm-one group gives ranks; root inversion and simple-root Hensel uniqueness give phi(r) parameters. A totient sum equals the number of all parameters. Direct complete finite-fiber checks passed for 7,129 parameters across 21 levels.

originality.rationale: Soohyun Park (arXiv:1407.8086, Section 4) studies modulo-p ranks and raises the modulo-prime-power coefficient-dependence question; Theorem 20 gives only rank <= p^k+1. Li (2000) is modulo primes. The exact rank-and-fiber formula for all p^k is stronger and not stated in examined texts. Full search does not prove novelty; a specialized trace-order count could be relevant.
residual_risks: A specialized formula counting orders of trace classes in split and unramified norm-one groups might be equivalent without using generalized-Fibonacci terminology; not all historic number-theory literature can be exhaustively ruled out.
The case t=-1, p>=5 is deliberately specialized; no assertion of an arbitrary-t or small-prime theorem.

value.rationale: Park 2014 explicitly identifies rank modulo prime powers as an interesting unsolved direction. The new theorem gives every possible rank and precise frequency for arbitrary coefficients across all p>=5 and all k, identifies the exceptional ramified stratum, and makes the known upper bound sharp in this family. It is a complete natural arithmetic classification rather than an isolated computation.
